note: Anonymized, hand-built sample offers for the team to build/demo against before offer-letter parsing works. Each is a valid POST body for /breakdown, /waterfall, /classify, /quality-score (nest under "ctc_breakup") and /gratuity-epf-timeline (use "joining_date" directly).

samples.label: Fresher — Non-Metro, Clean Offer
samples.description: Straightforward entry-level offer, no red flags expected: PF and gratuity both explicitly stated, notice period standard.

samples.label: Mid-Level — Metro, Bonus-Heavy
samples.description: Deliberately risky offer: variable pay far above the 30% CTC threshold, no gratuity clause, a long notice period, and a service bond — should trip HIGH_VARIABLE_PAY, MISSING_GRATUITY_CLAUSE, LONG_NOTICE_PERIOD and SERVICE_BOND red flags.

samples.label: Senior — High CTC, Old-Regime Deductions
samples.description: Higher-income offer with rent and 80C/80D deductions supplied, for exercising the old-vs-new regime comparison and HRA exemption path.
